# EZ-Tree

Upstream: https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree
Commit: dcf309bd86bd521083d9c70f01f2de45fdc7c457
License: MIT, see LICENSE (also included in embedded.js).

The unused lib directory has been removed. The current scene implements its trunk, roof ribs and leaves in ../../tree-model.js and does not import EZ-Tree. The license is retained for attribution compatibility with earlier offline builds.
